page: Vultr vcg-a40-24c-120g-48vram is a bare metal server belonging to the Dedicated Metal GPU family. It is equipped with an Intel x86_64 processor providing 24 dedicated vCPUs. The system configuration includes 120.0 GB of system memory, which equates to 5.0 GB of RAM per core. For local storage, the server features a 1400 GB NVMe SSD. Although classified under the Dedicated Metal GPU family with NVIDIA listed as the GPU manufacturer, the active GPU count for this specific configuration is reported as zero.

The server utilizes dedicated CPU allocation, ensuring that the 24 Intel vCPUs operate without resource contention from other tenants. The inclusion of 1400 GB of local NVMe SSD storage provides high-speed local read and write capabilities, which is beneficial for data-intensive operations. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the combination of dedicated x86_64 compute resources, a high-capacity NVMe storage drive, and a substantial 120.0 GB memory footprint offers a balanced resource density for workloads requiring dedicated hardware isolation without the overhead of virtualization.

This configuration is suitable for workloads that require dedicated CPU cores and fast local storage. Appropriate use cases include database hosting, data processing pipelines, web serving, and general-purpose enterprise applications that benefit from 120.0 GB of RAM and 1400 GB of NVMe SSD storage.
